### ST-035

**TypeScript program loader**

*As a **developer**, I want **SmartTest to load my TS project exactly as `tsc` sees it**, so that **aliases, project references and type-only imports are understood**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 5 | S2 | E01 | [ST-012](FND-core-project-foundation.md#st-012), [ST-023](DET-project-detection.md#st-023) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Honours tsconfig `extends`, `paths`, `references` and per-package configs
- [x] Type-only imports are recorded with a `type-only` flag
- [x] Files outside include globs are not analysed

---

### ST-036

**JavaScript parsing for ESM, CJS and JSX**

*As a **developer with a JS codebase**, I want **plain JS projects analysed too**, so that **I don't need TypeScript to benefit**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 5 | S2 | E02, §3.3 | [ST-012](FND-core-project-foundation.md#st-012) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Parses ESM `import`/`export`, CJS `require`/`module.exports` and JSX
- [x] Dynamic `import()` and computed `require()` are recorded as unresolved with reason
- [x] Express CJS fixture produces the expected relationships

---

### ST-037

**Symbol index**

*As a **SmartTest engine**, I want **every module, class, function, method, property and type indexed with stable ids**, so that **impact can be computed below file level**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 8 | S3 | E03, §9.2, §9.3 | [ST-035](SRC-source-intelligence.md#st-035), [ST-036](SRC-source-intelligence.md#st-036) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Symbols follow the `SourceSymbol` model with stable ids across unrelated edits
- [x] Qualified names are unique within a workspace
- [x] Index for each fixture matches its golden snapshot

---

### ST-038

**Import resolution**

*As a **developer**, I want **imports resolved through aliases, workspaces, `exports` maps and barrel files**, so that **dependencies across packages are not missed**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 8 | S3 | E04 | [ST-035](SRC-source-intelligence.md#st-035), [ST-036](SRC-source-intelligence.md#st-036), [ST-020](DET-project-detection.md#st-020) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Resolves relative, alias, workspace-package and `exports`-conditioned imports
- [x] Barrel re-exports are followed to the defining symbol
- [x] Every unresolved import is recorded with file, specifier and reason — never dropped

### ST-039

**Class, method and decorator analysis**

*As a **NestJS developer**, I want **classes, methods, inheritance and decorators analysed**, so that **rules and selection can target `*Service` methods precisely**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 5 | S4 | E05, §9.2 | [ST-037](SRC-source-intelligence.md#st-037) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Method visibility is recorded
- [x] NestJS fixture produces the expected class graph

### ST-040

**Export and public API analysis**

*As a **library author**, I want **the public API surface of each package computed**, so that **exported-API changes trigger broader verification**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 3 | S5 | E06 | [ST-038](SRC-source-intelligence.md#st-038) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Public API = symbols reachable from package entry points/`exports`
- [x] Exported vs internal is a symbol attribute
- [x] API surface diff is available to semantic diff

### ST-041

**Semantic diff with uncertainty**

*As a **developer**, I want **changes classified (comment-only, formatting, implementation, signature, exported API…)**, so that **trivial edits don't trigger large test runs and risky ones do**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 8 | S4 | E07, §9.4 | [ST-037](SRC-source-intelligence.md#st-037), [ST-027](VCS-version-control-and-native-snapshots.md#st-027), [ST-031](VCS-version-control-and-native-snapshots.md#st-031) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Classifies every §9.4 kind and maps changed ranges to symbols
- [x] Each classification has a confidence; anything unclear is `unclassifiable` (never 'no-op')
- [x] Comment/formatting-only changes are only treated as no-op in FAST mode, never in SAFE

---

### ST-042

**Incremental parsing and persistent index**

*As a **developer**, I want **only changed and invalidated files re-parsed**, so that **warm analysis stays fast on large repos**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 5 | S5 | E08, §9.5 | [ST-037](SRC-source-intelligence.md#st-037), [ST-045](GRA-dependency-graph.md#st-045) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Second run with one changed file re-parses only that file and its invalidated dependents
- [x] Index invalidates on tsconfig/package.json changes
- [x] Warm diff analysis < 500 ms on the medium benchmark repo

### ST-043

**Generated-code policies**

*As a **developer**, I want **generated directories handled by explicit rules**, so that **build output never pollutes the graph**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Should | 3 | S5 | E10, §9.6 | [ST-023](DET-project-detection.md#st-023) |

**Status:** partial — `exclude` works and referenced generated files are tracked through the graph; a generator-input → output mapping for `rebuild-required` is not implemented.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Config option `generated: [{ path, policy: exclude | test-source | rebuild-required }]`
- [ ] Detected generated dirs (e.g. `.next`, `dist`) are excluded by default
- [ ] Changes to a generator's input mark `rebuild-required` outputs as affected
